item.title: Kanazawa Castle & Gyokusen-inmaru Garden: Seat of the Powerful Maeda Clan — Guide
item.description: Kanazawa Castle was once the seat of the Maeda clan, rulers of the Kaga domain and the wealthiest feudal domain in Japan during the Edo period, though the original castle structure was lost to repeated fires over the centuries and much of what visitors see today is careful modern reconstruction using traditional techniques. Adjacent to the castle grounds, the Gyokusen-inmaru Garden was restored and reopened in 2015 after being rediscovered through historical research, offering a quieter garden counterpart to the crowds at nearby Kenrokuen.
